title: A Bio-Inspired Event-Driven Mechanoluminescent Visuotactile Sensor for Intelligent Interactions
actual_software_task: Event detection, localization, and interaction classification
software_pipeline: DLLM compares total and local light intensity with dual thresholds; extracts radial distance and light-distribution centroid direction; CNN classifies eight interactions
required_inputs_or_hardware: Image sequence, sensor geometry, interaction-class training labels
implemented_translation: Debounced threshold-defined optical events; accumulate ROI evidence only during the event; emit one discrete ROI at completion
fit_rationale: The event-driven and dual-threshold concepts match transient mechanoluminescence. CNN classification is excluded because this archive has neither the same eight-class task nor sufficient event labels.
source_basis: Attached PDF review plus Elicit Force Estimation and Force Localization fields

title: A Soft Mechanoluminescent Skin for High-Resolution Optical Tactile Sensing in Human-Machine Interaction
software_pipeline: Noise filtering, background subtraction, adaptive thresholding, feature extraction, centroid calculation, then functional-region lookup
required_inputs_or_hardware: CMOS images and a spatially calibrated skin
implemented_translation: Retain baseline normalization, temporal filtering, adaptive unloaded threshold, and fixed-region output; replace centroid with accumulated fixed-ROI argmax
fit_rationale: Its image-conditioning sequence fits the current optical pipeline. Continuous centroid coordinates would overstate the nine-ROI archive resolution, so only the region abstraction is retained.
source_basis: Attached PDF review plus Elicit Force Estimation and Force Localization fields

title: Visualizing Dynamic Mechanical Actions with High Sensitivity and High Resolution by Near-Distance Mechanoluminescence Imaging
actual_software_task: Stress magnitude estimation and spatial visualization
software_pipeline: Compute total gray value and photon count, fit two linear regimes against force, and apply the fit within image areas
reported_output: Estimated stress magnitude and stress distribution
required_inputs_or_hardware: Near-distance imaging plus force-calibration pairs spanning both regimes
implemented_translation: No Newton conversion; retain only a unitless peak optical score divided by the live unloaded threshold
fit_rationale: The paper supports intensity-based calibration only when matched force-light calibration pairs exist. This archive lacks event-level peak calibration in the declared operating band, so its force fit is not transferable.
source_basis: Attached PDF review plus Elicit Force Estimation and Force Localization fields

title: Multi-Dimensional Mechanical Mapping Sensor Based on Flexoelectric-Like and Optical Signals
actual_software_task: Load-magnitude inference, stress mapping, and object-center localization
software_pipeline: Use linear optical/electrical response for magnitude; extract image grayscale distribution; calculate barycenter with OpenCV
reported_output: Load magnitude, dynamic stress map, and barycenter
required_inputs_or_hardware: Optical images, electrical channel, calibrated load series, OpenCV
implemented_translation: Use positive normalized optical activity for localization, but aggregate it into one fixed ROI per event
fit_rationale: Grayscale spatial evidence is compatible. The electrical channel and continuous barycenter are absent or outside the requested fixed-ROI output contract; a Newton fit is not justified by the available event data.
source_basis: Attached PDF review plus Elicit Force Estimation and Force Localization fields

title: Ultrasensitive and Robust Mechanoluminescent Living Composites
actual_software_task: Dynamic light-response prediction from deformation and stress
software_pipeline: Fit an ODE mechanotransduction model using maximal intensity, peak duration, deformation rate, and nominal stress from controlled strip tests
required_inputs_or_hardware: Bioluminescent living composite, controlled uniaxial tests, rate and stress measurements
implemented_translation: Report a completed event's optical peak and boundaries; do not fit the biochemical ODE
fit_rationale: The work shows that transient light is event- and rate-dependent, supporting event-level reporting. Its living-material ODE and parameters are not applicable to the present inorganic nine-ROI optical archive.
source_basis: Attached PDF review plus Elicit Force Estimation and Force Localization fields

title: Dual-Modal Sensing Skin Adaptive to Daylight, Darkness, and Ultraviolet Light for Simultaneous Full-Field Deformation Measurement and Mechanoluminescence Responses
software_pipeline: Run digital image correlation with Ncorr using NCC/NLSC matching; use Python for error analysis
required_inputs_or_hardware: Trackable speckle texture, calibrated image geometry, DIC software
fit_rationale: The current features are nine aggregated optical ROIs, not texture-resolved images with a calibrated DIC pattern. Implementing DIC would require different acquisition hardware and data.
source_basis: Attached PDF review plus Elicit Force Estimation and Force Localization fields

title: Ratiometric Mechanoluminescence of Double-Activator Doped Phosphatic Phosphors: Color-Resolved Visualization of Stress-Sensing and Quantified Evaluation for Sensing Performance
actual_software_task: Force estimation from a color ratio
software_pipeline: Integrate two activator emission bands, calculate MLIR as their ratio, and fit a linear MLIR-force relation
required_inputs_or_hardware: Two spectrally separable activators and calibrated spectral intensities
fit_rationale: Ratiometric estimation is attractive for robustness but the archive exposes brightness-like ROI features, not two calibrated emission bands. The required spectral hardware signal is unavailable.
source_basis: Attached PDF review plus Elicit Force Estimation and Force Localization fields

title: Visually Encoded Mechanoluminescence through Hierarchical Structuring with Microscale Patterns and Nanoscale Features
actual_software_task: Pattern-based stress visualization rather than a trained software estimator
software_pipeline: Encode sensitivity physically using hierarchical structures; capture dynamic contrast patterns
implemented_translation: Keep localization claims discrete and optical; no software model is copied
fit_rationale: The study supports the legitimacy of spatial optical patterns but achieves localization mainly through material architecture. That architecture is not present in this sensor, so it cannot supply a transferable estimator.
source_basis: Attached PDF review plus Elicit Force Estimation and Force Localization fields
